scope: Strict float32 division through shared scalar/tensor IR, CPU ranked loops and tasks, and rank-one/rank-two GPU helpers.

semantics.rounding: nearest-ties-to-even; gradual underflow; signed zero; signed infinity on finite overflow and nonzero/zero
semantics.invalid: zero/zero, infinity/infinity and NaN operands produce canonical arithmetic quiet NaN 0x7fc00000
semantics.lowering: Normalized integer quotient/remainder with guard/round/sticky bits; safe integer divisor in eagerly evaluated select arms; no hardware floating division or reciprocal approximation.
semantics.composition: Source order retained; 5/3 is 3fd55555 while 5*(1/3) is 3fd55556.
semantics.shape: Tensor operands require equal rank and all extents; scalars lift on either side. Static faults reject transactionally; dynamic faults fail before element reads.
semantics.limits: float32 subset; GPU dense ranks one/two; scalar division inside GPU helper closures does not admit arbitrary scalar-returning GPU entry points.
semantics.runtime: No ABI, ownership or implicit transfer changes. Existing direct and Tier 2 layouts retained.
